annotations.text:
Copy rule held throughout: "when to reorder," never "when to take."

No usage rates, no supply projections, no adherence or intake language anywhere on these surfaces — spec §2. Everything the customer sees is framed as shipment timing.

Bracketed values are placeholders for facts the spec hasn't settled: the recurring discount %, product names (WooCommerce owns catalog), addresses, order IDs.

Phase 6 surface. The router leaves the admin group deliberately empty today, so none of this is built yet.

These views read the projected read models in spec §8 — not the write tables. The failure queue's ladder is the T+0 / T+3d / T+7d dunning sequence from §7; the event log strip is the append-only ScheduleEvent table.
